items.label: World Canvas
items.description: Infinite spatial canvas for visual knowledge organisation — pan, zoom, and arrange nodes freely in a persistent world layout.

items.label: Project Dashboard
items.description: At-a-glance project health: node growth charts, tag distribution, recent activity, word count trends, and Kanban throughput metrics.

items.label: WYSIWYG Editor
items.description: Rich text editor with Markdown shortcut support, inline formatting, code blocks, tables, and attachment embeds.

items.label: AI Assistant
items.description: Multi-provider AI assistant (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) with 71 tools — write, search, create and link nodes, run Kanban ops, and query your graph.

items.label: Whisper Dictation
items.description: Offline speech-to-text dictation powered by Whisper.cpp — transcribes directly into the node editor without a cloud round-trip.

items.label: Kanban Board
items.description: Drag-and-drop Kanban board with custom workflow statuses, WIP limits, and swimlanes — built on top of the node graph.

items.label: Kanban Timeline View
items.description: Gantt-style timeline view for Kanban items with drag-to-reschedule, dependency arrows, and quarter grouping.

items.label: Live-Write Export
items.description: Continuously export a node's content to a watched folder on disk — enables seamless round-trip editing with external tools.

items.label: Node Aliases
items.description: Create named shortcuts for frequently accessed nodes; aliases resolve transparently across views and links.

items.label: Refine Whisper Dictation
items.description: Whole refactoring of the Whisper integration. Better and faster Word detection.

items.label: Semantic Search
items.description: Vector-based semantic search across all node content — find related notes by meaning, not just keyword matches, using local embeddings.

items.label: CSV Import
items.description: Import rows from a CSV file as nodes in bulk — map columns to node fields, tags, and connection targets with a preview wizard.

items.label: MCP Server
items.description: Built-in Model Context Protocol server — exposes your graph to any MCP-compatible AI client (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Zed, etc.) over a local port.

items.label: Achievements & Milestones
items.description: Unlock achievements for reaching writing goals, building large graphs, and mastering features — a lightweight motivational layer built into the app.

items.label: Auto Bug Watcher & Recovery Wizard
items.description: Background error monitor that detects white-screens and runtime errors, records a ring-buffer of breadcrumbs, and guides users through one-click bug reports.

items.label: Dashboard Widget System
items.description: Composable dashboard widgets — add custom metrics panels, saved views, tag clouds, and AI summaries to your project home screen.

items.label: Smart Clusters
items.description: AI-assisted automatic grouping of canvas nodes by semantic similarity — suggests and applies cluster labels with one click.

items.label: Auth System
items.description: Account creation and team management — lay the foundation for cloud sync, shared projects, and real-time collaboration.

items.label: Cross-Project Links
items.description: Create typed connections that span multiple projects — reference a node in Project B from a node in Project A with live resolution.

items.label: Real-Time Collaboration
items.description: Live multi-user editing of shared projects — presence indicators, conflict-free node merges via CRDT, and team-space management.

items.label: Web Viewer Public Sharing
items.description: Publish a read-only web snapshot of any project to a public URL — no account required for viewers; sharable graphs, Kanban boards, and node content.

items.label: Canvas Sketching
items.description: Draw shapes, freeform ink, and annotate directly on the canvas — sticky notes, arrows, and pen-style markup without leaving the app.

items.label: Pinned Nodes on Canvas
items.description: Pin important nodes to fixed screen positions so they stay visible while panning — ideal for reference anchors and always-accessible entry points.

items.label: Notion Import
items.description: One-click import wizard for Notion exports — maps pages to nodes, databases to projects, and preserves backlinks and nested page hierarchies.

items.label: Plugin System
items.description: Public plugin API for community extensions — custom node types, toolbar actions, sidebar panels, and IPC hooks via a sandboxed runtime.

items.label: Mobile Companion
items.description: Lightweight mobile app for capturing quick notes and viewing your graph on the go — syncs with the desktop app over a local network or cloud.
